summary: Senior Backend Engineer with over 4 years of experience designing scalable microservices and event-driven architectures. Proficient in Python (Django, FastAPI) with growing expertise in Go and cloud-native technologies including AWS (Lambda, S3) and Kubernetes. Proven track record of optimizing high-traffic systems and implementing container orchestration strategies to enhance deployment efficiency.

bullets: Designed and implemented scalable RESTful microservices using Python and FastAPI, supporting high-traffic logistics operations.
Deployed serverless functions using AWS Lambda and the Serverless framework, reducing infrastructure overhead by 30%.
Managed containerized application deployments in a staging Kubernetes environment using kubectl to ensure high availability.
Optimized database queries for PostgreSQL and implemented Redis caching strategies, reducing API response times by 40%.
Assisted in architecting core application services using Flask and PostgreSQL.
Integrated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions to automate testing and deployment workflows.
Collaborated with frontend teams to integrate APIs and ensure seamless data flow.
